Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODFrame

GetSequenceNumber

The GetSequenceNumber method returns the sequence number of this frame in its frame group. 
ODULong GetSequenceNumber ();
return value
The sequence number of this frame, expressed as an unsigned 32-bit value.
SEE ALSO
The ODFrame::ChangeSequenceNumber method (page 311).
"Grouping Display Frames" on page 113 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
"Creating Frame Groups" on page 124 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
